facts.fact: Decree 2026-617 of the President of Benin, signed 18 September 2026 and effective from signature, requires fees for acts issued by the justice chancellery and the courts, tax stamps included, to be paid only electronically, with receipts going to a dedicated Treasury account; no platform or go-live is named.
facts.system: online payment of court and chancellery fees

systems.system: online payment platforms for court and chancellery fees
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Economy and Finance
